input.quote: Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation
input.rationale: Sections 13.1–13.3 meet the preferred position: Affiliates and contractors are covered, paid-up and embedded software is licensed perpetually and irrevocably, revocation is limited to material uncured breach after notice and cure, and rights are transferable to an Affiliate or successor. The narrower Deliverable licence in Section 14.2 is addressed under the IP rule rather than flagged twice here.

input.quote: Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours
input.rationale: Section 22 matches the preferred position: once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, business hours, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no direct access to our systems or unrelated data.
